[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
1. `packages/cli/src/lib/agentic-setup.ts:180` generates the Playwright config at `.ai/qa/playwright.config.ts`, but standalone apps and the CLI integration runner both look for `.ai/qa/tests/playwright.config.ts` (`packages/create-app/template/package.json.template:20`, `packages/cli/src/lib/testing/integration.ts:215`). I reproduced this by building the CLI and running `agentic:init` in a temp app fixture: the command only created `.ai/qa/playwright.config.ts`. That means an existing app that uses `agentic:init` still won’t have the config file required by `yarn test:integration` or `mercato test:integration`.

2. The new Playwright coverage does not protect that contract. `.ai/qa/tests/integration/TC-INT-008.spec.ts:82` maps shared source files straight to `.ai/...`, and `:181` uses that derived list as the assertion set, so the test encodes the same wrong destination path instead of checking the runnable standalone-app layout. I ran `npx playwright test --config .ai/qa/tests/playwright.config.ts .ai/qa/tests/integration/TC-INT-008.spec.ts --retries=0`; it passes even though the generated fixture is missing `.ai/qa/tests/playwright.config.ts`, so this regression would ship undetected.
[implementer-agent] Updated: Branch fix/hackon/hck-0093-tests-add-low-level-coverage-for-agentic-setup-ts was synchronized by the coordinator.

[reviewer-agent] Ready: No blocking findings.

I reviewed the branch diff around [`packages/cli/src/lib/agentic-setup.ts`](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0093/packages/cli/src/lib/agentic-setup.ts), the paired build/bootstrap changes, and the new Playwright coverage in [`packages/cli/src/lib/__integration__/TC-INT-008.spec.ts`](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0093/packages/cli/src/lib/__integration__/TC-INT-008.spec.ts). The implementation is internally consistent: the CLI now copies the same standalone agentic assets and guide files as `create-app`, `agentic:init` is bootstrap-free, and the QA config path is aligned to `.ai/qa/tests/playwright.config.ts` across the touched surfaces.

Validation evidence I checked:
- `npx playwright test --config .ai/qa/tests/playwright.config.ts packages/cli/src/lib/__integration__/TC-INT-008.spec.ts --retries=0` passed.
- `npx playwright test --config .ai/qa/tests/playwright.config.ts --list` includes `packages/cli/src/lib/__integration__/TC-INT-008.spec.ts`, so the new test is discoverable by the standard integration runner.

Residual risk is limited to broader packaged standalone parity, since I did not rerun the heavier `yarn test:create-app:integration` flow in this review.
